remarks: Step into this beautifully maintained Colonial, boasting 3 bedrooms and 2.5 baths. The main floor features gleaming hardwood floors throughout. The updated kitchen is a chef's delight with stainless steel appliances and an adjacent dining room perfect for busy weekday meals or for more formal holiday dinners. The inviting front to back living room, complete with a fireplace, offers a warm and comfortable space for cozy movie nights or for entertaining friend and family. Enjoy your morning coffee in the sun porch or catch up on laundry with the conveniently located half bath and laundry area on this floor. Upstairs, you'll find a full bath and three spacious bedrooms, including the Primary suite which features generous closet space and a full bath with a jet tub. Located close to restaurants, shopping, and walking trails, with easy access to the Merritt Parkway, Route 7 and I-95, this home offers both comfort and convenience. Don't miss the opportunity to lease this charming Colonial! No Pets. Tenants responsible for oil heat propane for cooking gas and half of landscaping and snow removal. Agent-owner related.
